items.meta_title: Send a Diagnosis Report | VpnHood! CLIENT and CONNECT
items.meta_description: How to run Diagnose in VpnHood! CLIENT or VpnHood! CONNECT, open the report and send it to support, and what the report holds before you share it.
items.title: Send a diagnosis report
items.lead: When the app will not connect or keeps dropping, a diagnosis report shows our support team what went wrong. The steps are the same in VpnHood! CLIENT and VpnHood! CONNECT.
items.step_open: Open the menu at the top of the home screen and tap Diagnose. The app connects and records what happens.
items.step_repeat: Use your device as you did when the problem happened, until you see it again.
items.step_report: A message appears when the app has stopped. Tap Open Report in it.
items.step_send: Share the report with the button at the top of its page and send it to support@vpnhood.com, with a few words about the problem. On a computer, that button copies it. If you have no such button, send a screenshot: the report opens at its end, the part that matters most.
items.tip_error: If an error message shows a Diagnose button, you can tap that instead of opening the menu.
items.holds_desc: The report is plain text that stays on your device until you send it, so you can read it first. It holds:
items.holds_app: The app's version, your system and your country.
items.holds_settings: Your app settings as you set them, such as a custom DNS server or split tunneling rules.
items.holds_steps: Each step of the connection and any errors. IP addresses and host names are masked here.
items.holds_not: It does not hold the sites you visit or the content of your traffic.
